decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to maintain because it runs on existing production and logistics, it is still mentioned in 2024, and its value is not yet fully revealed, so keeping the option open is sensible.

The seventy-two-hour program is costlier to sustain and overlaps with the other express offers, but it remained on the website in 2024 and has had too little time to show it has failed, so the option stays open for now.
With a dedicated page in both years, the express program for doors and gates looks like the umbrella offer that has gained commitment, so its value appears to be materializing.

The online ordering and digital services platform has a page of its own, fits the firm's strategy of deeper service support, and its strategic option value is still growing, so abandoning it makes no sense.

The fire and smoke protection door was upgraded to its own page in 2024 and apparently replaced the dropped fire-resistant door C, which signals that uncertainty has resolved in its favor and justifies further commitment.
